nodes.label: HBM3E
nodes.what: Fifth-generation high-bandwidth memory stacks used on current AI accelerators.
nodes.why_matters: Still the volume workhorse while HBM4 ramps; shortage here immediately caps GPU/ASIC shipments.
nodes.falsify: Sustained HBM3E oversupply with short lead times across all three suppliers.

nodes.label: HBM4
nodes.what: Sixth-generation HBM with wider interface and higher bandwidth per stack.
nodes.why_matters: Required for next-gen accelerators (e.g. Vera Rubin class); ramp timing gates platform launches.
nodes.falsify: Multiple suppliers shipping qualified HBM4 ahead of demand with spare capacity.

nodes.label: HBM Base Die
nodes.what: Logic/base die under the DRAM stack providing the HBM host interface.
nodes.why_matters: Can limit stack bandwidth, height, and package integration even when DRAM wafers exist.
nodes.falsify: Base-die capacity and yields cease to constrain stack shipments.

nodes.label: HBM Stacking / Bonding
nodes.what: TSV / hybrid bonding assembly of DRAM dies into HBM cubes.
nodes.why_matters: Stack height and yield determine bits per package footprint.
nodes.falsify: 16-high+ stacks shipping at mature yields with no assembly bottleneck.

nodes.label: HBM Test
nodes.what: Known-good-stack test and burn-in for HBM cubes before package attach.
nodes.why_matters: Test throughput and coverage gate shippable supply and field reliability.
nodes.falsify: Test capacity unused while stacks wait on other constraints.

nodes.label: CoWoS
nodes.what: TSMC CoWoS-class 2.5D advanced packaging attaching logic + HBM on interposer.
nodes.why_matters: De facto AI accelerator package path; capacity gap has been repeatedly called out by TSMC management.
nodes.falsify: TSMC states CoWoS supply meets demand with spare allocation and short lead times.

nodes.label: Advanced Interposer
nodes.what: Silicon / RDL interposer carrying dense die-to-die and HBM interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Physical carrier for CoWoS-class packages; yield and size limit multi-HBM designs.
nodes.falsify: Interposer supply no longer limits CoWoS starts.

nodes.label: Package Substrate
nodes.what: Organic / advanced substrates under the package for board-level interconnect.
nodes.why_matters: Large AI packages stress substrate supply and layer counts.
nodes.falsify: Substrate lead times normalize while packaging slots remain idle.

nodes.label: Hybrid Bonding
nodes.what: Cu-Cu / dielectric hybrid bonding used in SoIC and dense 3D stacking.
nodes.why_matters: Enables tighter pitches than microbumps; critical for SoIC and taller stacks.
nodes.falsify: Hybrid-bonded capacity abundant relative to AI demand.

nodes.label: Advanced Packaging Yield
nodes.what: End-to-end yield of multi-die AI packages (interposer + HBM + logic).
nodes.why_matters: Yield multiplies effective capacity; poor yield turns wafer starts into scrap.
nodes.falsify: Package yields mature enough that capacity is limited only by tool counts.

nodes.label: Package Test
nodes.what: Final / system-level test of assembled AI accelerator packages.
nodes.why_matters: Complex multi-die packages require long test times; can throttle shipments.
nodes.falsify: Package test queues empty while earlier steps constrain.

nodes.label: Electrical SerDes
nodes.what: High-speed electrical SerDes for package and board reach.
nodes.why_matters: Current scale-up path before optics; power/reach limits push toward CPO.
nodes.falsify: Electrical I/O meets bandwidth/power targets without optical transition.

nodes.label: Silicon Photonics
nodes.what: Silicon photonic circuits integrating optical I/O with electronics.
nodes.why_matters: Foundation for CPO switches and future package optical I/O.
nodes.falsify: Photonic capacity and yields exceed CPO demand.

nodes.label: Optical Engine
nodes.what: Integrated optical engine modules co-packaged with switch/accelerator ASICs.
nodes.why_matters: Engine assembly/yield sits between photonics dies and usable CPO systems.
nodes.falsify: Optical engines commoditized with multiple qualified sources.

nodes.label: CPO Integration
nodes.what: Co-packaged optics integration of optics onto switch/ASIC packages.
nodes.why_matters: Required to scale AI fabrics beyond pluggable transceiver power/density limits.
nodes.falsify: CPO shipping at volume with yields matching pluggables and spare capacity.

nodes.label: Laser Source
nodes.what: Laser sources feeding silicon photonic engines (external or integrated).
nodes.why_matters: Laser count, reliability, and supply can limit CPO economics and scale.
nodes.falsify: Laser supply is abundant and not on CPO critical path.

nodes.label: Bonding Equipment
nodes.what: Hybrid / thermo-compression bonding tools for HBM and SoIC.
nodes.why_matters: Tool lead times and install rates cap stacking and 3D packaging ramps.
nodes.falsify: Bonding tools idle while other constraints bind.

nodes.label: Inspection / Metrology
nodes.what: Inspection and metrology for bonding, interposers, and advanced packages.
nodes.why_matters: Yield learning and outbound quality depend on metrology throughput.
nodes.falsify: Metrology no longer gates packaging starts.

nodes.label: Advanced Test Equipment
nodes.what: ATE and burn-in systems for HBM stacks and AI packages.
nodes.why_matters: Long test times on expensive packages create a silent capacity wall.
nodes.falsify: Test equipment utilization low while front-end constraints dominate.
